newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chiyoda Mutual, Taisei to build 30 bln yen complex.
newsitem.headline: Chiyoda Mutual, Taisei to build 30 bln yen complex.

text.p: Chiyoda Mutual Life Insurance Co said on Wednesday that it and construction company Taisei Corp would jointly develop an office and shopping complex on prime land in central Tokyo.
Investment is expected to be at around 30 billion yen, a Chiyoda official said.
Chiyoda and Taisei plan to build a 30-storey complex with offices, shops and condominiums on some 8,900 square metres of land in Akasaka, the official said.
The land is owned by a Chiyoda affiliate, he said.
Construction is expected to start in April 1, 1998, and to be completed in 2001/02, he said.
